synthetic_model: Per-link conditional coverage probabilities are sampled with replacement from the 30 empirical UVA sensor-gateway coverage fractions. Independent Bernoulli reception rates are calibrated so that, after conditioning on at least one gateway reception, the target marginal coverage fractions are recovered in expectation.
important_scope_note: The synthetic generator preserves the marginal per-link coverage distribution, not the full empirical cross-gateway dependence structure.
